provenance.catalogueScope: Confirmed planets from the NASA Exoplanet Archive Planetary Systems Composite Parameters table.
provenance.selection: Converted the complete projected TAP result locally, required planet name, host, distance, radius, mass, period and semi-major axis, then retained the first 128 rows after deterministic sorting.
provenance.numericConversion: Numeric source cells were converted with Number; only finite values were retained.
provenance.nullPolicy: Empty, absent or non-finite optional source values remain null. No value was imputed, interpolated or synthesized by this project.
provenance.sort: distancePc ascending, then host ascending, then planet name ascending.
